info.name: Course Registration System
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Course Registration System microservices.

**Setup**
1. Import this file into Postman.
2. Run **Auth → Login as Admin** — the token is saved automatically to `{{accessToken}}`.
3. Create requests (faculties, departments, courses, programs, etc.) auto-save their IDs into collection variables.

**Base URL**: `http://localhost:3000` — change `{{baseUrl}}` in collection variables for other environments.

See `docs/auth-and-roles.md` for the full permission matrix.

item.description:
Run AFTER Admin Setup Flow. Demonstrates the full enrollment sequence including prerequisite enforcement:
1. Register Student
2. Login as Student → saves {{studentToken}}
3. (Admin) Create Student Profile → saves {{studentId}}
4. (Admin) Assign Curriculum to Student
5. Enroll in CSC101 (no prerequisites)
6. Try to enroll in CSC201 → fails (CSC101 not yet completed)
7. (Admin) Mark CSC101 complete
8. Enroll in CSC201 → succeeds
